Дибекацина Сульфат C18H37N5O8,xH2SO4. CAS — 34493-98-6 (dibekacin); 58580-55-5 (dibekacin sulfate). ATC — J01GB09. ATC Vet — QJ01GB09. (dibekacin) Pharmacopoeias. In Jpn. Profile Dibekacin is an aminoglycoside derived from kanamycin with actions and uses similar to those of gentamicin (p.282). It has been given intramuscularly as the sulfate in doses equivalent to dibekacin 1 to 3 mg/kg daily in divided doses. It has also been given in similar doses by slow intravenous infusion. Dosage should be adjusted based on serum-dibekacin concentration monitoring. It has also been used topically for eye infections.
